thread:
sara: heads-up — we had a p99 spike (~1.2s) across chat/long-context routes right after last night's autoscale event. looks correlated with node join + burst capacity being handed out. suspect KV cache cold misses + microbatch sizing oddities.
raj: can you paste the trace and which model/route exactly?
sara: route=chat/long-context, model=redwood-13b-quant, env=prod-dedicated. snapshot at 02:14 UTC: p50=82ms p95=360ms p99=1.2s. scale event added +2 nodes, traffic redistributed.
jen: fyi — last week's kernel-selector change leaves new nodes at the baseline kernel until the node profiler converges. that means fused-attn/etc might not be used immediately. combine that with empty KV and microbatches = bad tail.
raj: dug into profiler traces. cold node vs hot node for seq_len=1024: attention kernel latency ~= 3x on cold node. also saw microbatch auto-adapter drop batch_size -> 1 during warmup because queue depth heuristic sees variable latency. snippet from perf trace:
```
# node a (hot): attn_kernel=fused_v2 latency=12ms
# node b (cold): attn_kernel=generic latency=36ms
# microbatch: target=8 -> observed=1 for 60s
```
miguel: so two independent contributors: kernel mismatch + batching heuristic oscillation + KV misses. mitigation candidates: delay routing to new nodes until kernel profile matches golden, or force kernel prewarm; and prefill KV cache by replaying recent prefixes. :thinking_face:
perf-bot: collected perf traces and uploaded bundle -> s3://redwood-perf/traces/1765554321.tar.gz
jen: quick mitigation proposal: 1) run low-priority kernel prewarm job on newly provisioned nodes (small synthetic inferences to land fused kernels), 2) bump microbatch floor to 4 for the first 5 minutes after node join, 3) replay top-200 prefixes to prime KV cache. memory impact should be transient.
raj: memory/costs look acceptable for a short prewarm window, but need rollback if it increases token bill unexpectedly. also add metric for "node_kernel_mismatch_ratio" so autoscaler can make smarter routing choices.
sara: I'll run a canary in prod-dedicated tonight with those two mitigations (kernel prewarm + temporary microbatch bump). will report p99 before/after. if p99 goes back to ~300-350ms we can rollout.
infra-bot: created incident INC-2026-042 and attached runbook: /runbooks/autoscale-kernel-warmup. assigned: @sara, @raj, @jen
miguel: also filing follow-up ticket to add a gating check in the autoscaler: hold routing until kernel_hash == golden_hash OR node has served X warm requests. helps avoid routing to slow kernels during scale-up.
sara: thanks — let's keep this thread updated with canary numbers. i'll post the p50/p95/p99 deltas and the cost delta after the 30m window. :thumbsup:
